extensions.name: mcrypt
extensions.why: PrestaShop 1.6 itself, not just its modules: its Cookie class builds Rijndael from _RIJNDAEL_KEY_/_RIJNDAEL_IV_ unconditionally, and the installer only writes those when mcrypt is loaded, so a 1.6 shop without it cannot log into the back office. Dead after 7.x. 7.2+ is PECL -- pecl.lock pins 1.0.9, whose package.xml declares a 7.2.0 floor; 7.0 and 7.1 still carry ext/mcrypt in php-src, so the overrides build that instead of a package that refuses them

extensions.name: mongodb
extensions.why: Laravel MongoDB driver for document-store integrations -- pecl.lock pins 2.3.3, whose own configure refuses anything below PHP 8.1 ("Need a PHP version >= 8.1.0"); this constraint was >=7.0 and untested below 8.5 until task 14's PHP 8.0 build hit it for real

extensions.name: msgpack
extensions.why: Opt-in compact serialization for high-throughput Laravel queues

extensions.name: pcov
extensions.why: PHPUnit code-coverage driver for Laravel/PrestaShop CI pipelines

extensions.name: protobuf
extensions.why: gRPC clients used by Laravel microservice integrations -- pecl.lock pins 5.35.1, whose package.xml declares an 8.2.0 floor. Task 14 hit this as a mid-compile failure on 8.0 (arginfo stubs php_protobuf references that 8.0's Zend headers do not declare) and worked around it with a per-version skip in build-shared-ext.sh; task 15 replaced that with the real floor, the way mongodb's was

extensions.name: snmp
extensions.why: Legacy PrestaShop server-monitoring modules polling network devices. Links the vendored client-only net-snmp (deps/build-netsnmp.sh), not Debian's libsnmp40t64, which hard-depends on libperl5.40

extensions.name: ssh2
extensions.why: Laravel deployment tooling SSH/SFTP automation. Default pin 1.5.0 declares an 8.0.0 floor, so 7.0-7.4 pin 1.3.1 (declares 7.0.0, no max)

extensions.name: swoole
extensions.why: Laravel Octane's high-performance async application server -- pecl.lock pins 6.2.2, whose own php_swoole_private.h #errors "require PHP version 8.2 or later" (Fiber support, zend_fibers.h); this constraint was >=7.2 and untested below 8.5 until task 14's PHP 8.0 build hit it for real

extensions.name: tidy
extensions.why: WordPress/PrestaShop legacy HTML cleanup on import

extensions.name: uuid
extensions.why: Laravel UUID primary keys without the pure-PHP fallback

extensions.name: xdebug
extensions.why: Local debugging/profiling for Laravel and PrestaShop development, never in production. always_available marks it as one of the extensions every image must carry, whatever the pins say -- an explicit user requirement ("quick debug and recover remotely") that the 7.x images silently lost when a pin bump raised the floor, and that scripts/test_ext_registry.py now enforces. Every image has one: the default pin (3.5.3) declares an 8.0.0 floor, so 7.0-7.4 pin the newest release that declares support for each -- 3.1.6 covers 7.2-7.4 (declares 7.2.0-8.1.99), 2.9.8 covers 7.1 (7.1.0-7.4.99), 2.6.1 covers 7.0 (7.0.0, no max). Ranges read from each candidate's own package.xml, not from release notes

extensions.name: yaml

extensions.name: snuffleupagus
extensions.why: Virtual patching and hardening; shipped disabled, opt-in per framework. conf/snuffleupagus/*.rules vendor this tag's config/default.rules: a bump here re-syncs them (procedure in default.rules' header), and scripts/test_ext_registry.py holds the two tags together
